purpose: Retrospective evidence-linked flood characterization; development pilot, no globally validated flood classifier or forecasts

cases.name: Chokwe, Mozambique
cases.scene_context: River floodplain with agricultural, vegetated and settled areas; no pixel-level land-cover labels

event_context.description: NASA documents Jan 5 and Jan 17 NISAR observations around the southern Mozambique flood. The reference window may include early wet-season flooding; this is change relative to that window, not a pristine counterfactual.

cases.name: Qadirabad / Chenab, Pakistan
cases.scene_context: Agricultural river corridor; independent optical water comparison does not validate under-canopy inundation

event_context.description: PMD/FFD regional Chenab bulletin context. No independently surveyed flood polygon is supplied and local inundation is not assumed.

cases.name: Whitewater River / Richmond, Indiana, USA
cases.scene_context: River corridor through settled and agricultural surroundings; urban context is not a building-level flood label

event_context.description: NWS reports heavy rain in Wayne County and rises on the Whitewater River. Short-lived flooding may fall between satellite acquisitions; absence of a later signal does not establish absence of flooding.

admission_notes: Oahu March 2026 was considered but no matching GCOV acquisitions were returned in beta, provisional or standard collections for the requested point/window.
All thresholds and optical-time limits are diagnostic policy choices fixed before the radar/reference agreement is inspected.
Candidate controls are optically stable predominantly nonwater cells matched on pre-event radar levels; they are not experimentally guaranteed unaffected controls.
